description: This file contains type definitions and the implementation of a custom Long class supporting 64-bit integer operations, including static constants, constructors, arithmetic, bitwise, comparison, and conversion methods. It defines a type alias LongLike for flexible input types and provides detailed documentation for each method.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class providing 64-bit two's-complement integer arithmetic, with support for signed and unsigned operations, conversions, and bitwise manipulations.

methods.name: constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean); constructor
methods.description: Constructs a 64-bit Long instance from low and optional high 32-bit parts, with optional unsigned flag.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a Long representing the sum of this and the specified LongLike value.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Returns the bitwise AND of this Long and the specified LongLike value.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares this Long's value with the specified's, returning a numeric comparison result.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Returns this Long divided by the specified LongLike divisor.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Tests if this Long's value equals the specified LongLike's.

methods.name: getHighBits
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getHighBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getLowBits
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getLowBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Tests if this Long's value is greater than the specified's.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Tests if this Long's value is less than the specified's.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Returns this Long modulo the specified LongLike.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Returns the product of this and the specified LongLike.

methods.name: negate
methods.description: Negates this Long's value.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Returns the bitwise NOT of this Long.

methods.name: toBigInt
methods.description: Converts this Long to a bigint.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts this Long to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts this Long to a floating-point number.

methods.name: toBytes
methods.description: Converts this Long to an array of bytes, with optional little-endian format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts this Long to its string representation in the specified radix.

methods.name: toUnsigned
methods.description: Converts this Long to an unsigned Long.

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^  constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean);$/
